products.name: Marble Incense Holder
products.fullTitle: Handcrafted Marble Incense Holder — Raw Stone, Quiet Ritual
products.blurb: A small ritual, carved in stone
products.seoDescription: Elevate your daily rituals with a handcrafted marble incense holder. Premium home décor designed for calm, mindful living across the UAE.
story: A small ritual, carved in stone. This incense holder is cut from natural marble — cool to the touch, honest in texture, with no two pieces exactly alike.
Light it during meditation, prayer, or simply the quiet minutes before bed. Let the smoke settle the room, and let the stone settle you.
features: A daily reset for your space

specs.Care: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth
specs.Note: Handmade — colour and veining vary piece to piece

products.name: Bamboo & Cane Hanging Lamps
products.fullTitle: Handmade Bamboo & Cane Hanging Lamps — Set of 3
products.seoDescription: Handcrafted bamboo and cane hanging lamps (set of 3) offering warm, natural lighting. Ideal for living rooms, dining areas and cosy interiors.
story: Light, filtered through something real. Hand-woven from natural bamboo and cane, these lamps let light pass through in soft, uneven patterns — never harsh, never perfect.

Hang them over a dining table, a reading corner, or a quiet hallway, and watch the room settle into a warmer glow. No two lamps are identical — the small irregularities are part of the craft, not a flaw in it.
features: Hand-woven bamboo and cane, set of 3
Soft, ambient light with natural shadow texture

specs.Includes: Bulb holder + 2 m wire with plug
specs.Care: Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth

products.name: Handpainted Wall Frames, Classic
products.fullTitle: Classic Handpainted Wooden Wall Frames — Elegant Artistic Wall Décor
products.seoDescription: Classic handpainted wooden wall frames — artistic detailing and premium craftsmanship for gallery walls and statement interiors.
story: Intricate handpainted detailing on premium wood, for walls that need warmth rather than another print.
Built for gallery arrangements and statement walls — living rooms, hallways, entryways — and equally at home in modern, traditional or layered interiors.
features: Made for gallery walls and statement arrangements

specs.Spaces: Living room, bedroom, hallway, entryway, office
specs.Care: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth only

products.name: Handpainted Wall Frame, Turquoise
products.fullTitle: Turquoise Handpainted Wooden Wall Frame — Artistic Luxury Wall Décor
products.blurb: One colour, held against a neutral wall
products.seoDescription: Turquoise handpainted wooden wall frame — artistic detailing and a rich finish for modern and bohemian interiors.
story: A rich turquoise finish over handpainted detailing — colour used the way a room can take it, in one place rather than everywhere.
Hang it alone against a neutral wall, or let it anchor a gallery arrangement of quieter frames.
features: Anchors a gallery wall or stands alone

specs.Spaces: Living room, bedroom, hallway, entryway, office
specs.Care: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth only

products.name: Krishna T-Light Holder
products.fullTitle: Krishna T-Light Candle Holder — Elegant Spiritual Home Décor
products.seoDescription: Krishna t-light candle holder — intricate detailing and warm candlelight for prayer corners, festive setups and modern interiors.
story: A Krishna-inspired form with intricate detailing, made to hold a single tea light and the warmth that comes with it.
For coffee tables, prayer corners, shelves and festive setups — Ramadan, Eid, Diwali, or an ordinary evening that deserves better light.

specs.Spaces: Living room, prayer room, bedroom, entryway, office
specs.Care: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth only

products.name: Silver Elephant Bowl
products.fullTitle: Silver Elephant Decorative Bowl — Elegant Luxury Home Décor
products.seoDescription: Silver elephant decorative bowl — a premium centrepiece for coffee tables, consoles and dining tables.
story: An elephant-inspired form in a premium silver finish — a centrepiece for a coffee table, a console, or a dining table that needs one considered object rather than five.
The elephant carries its own symbolism: wisdom, prosperity, strength. It reads as decoration first and meaning second, which is the right order.
features: Luxury silver finish with premium detailing
Centrepiece for coffee tables, consoles and shelves

specs.Spaces: Living room, dining room, bedroom, office, entryway
specs.Care: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth only

products.name: Sabai Grass Tea Light Holder
products.fullTitle: Handwoven Sabai Grass Tea Light Holder
products.seoDescription: Handwoven sabai grass tea light holder, made by rural artisans in Mayurbhanj, Odisha. Eco-friendly and one of a kind.
story: Mayurbhanj in Odisha is known as the land of tigers, and also for its handicrafts. This holder is woven there, by rural artisans, from sabai grass.
The grass is sun-dried, hand-twisted into rope, rubbed against tree bark to take off the rough edges, then braided. It is slow work, and it shows in the object.
features: One-of-a-kind by nature of the process

specs.Care: Wipe clean or dust with a soft, damp cloth

products.name: Dovetail Test Tube Planter
products.blurb: Cuttings, held in glass and wood
products.seoDescription: Dovetail wooden test tube planter — handmade from plywood and glass for cuttings and single stems.
story: Test tubes set into dovetailed wood, for cuttings, single stems and the kind of green that does not need a pot.
Made from wood, and left with its rustic aesthetic intact: knot holes, scratches and blemishes are part of the offering rather than faults in it.
